steps.instruction: Exit the Voorhees Computing Center and head east along the campus pedestrian paths.
Continue toward the Darrin Communications Center (DCC).
Walk toward the Low Center for Industrial Innovation.
Continue northeast toward the Quadrangle Complex.
Follow the pedestrian path to Russell Sage Dining Hall on the south side of the Quadrangle.

notes: Approximate campus walking route. Distance and time are estimates; individual pedestrian paths have not been verified.
